site_facts.quote: IN 2011, SAMUEL MARUTA AND VINCENT MOUROU WENT SOUL-SEARCHING INTO THE JUNGLES OF VIETNAM.
BECOMING VIETNAM’S FIRST BEAN-TO-BAR CHOCOLATE MAKER BY CONTROLLING EVERY STAGE OF PRODUCTION
USING 100% LOCAL INGREDIENTS, CRAFTED ENTIRELY IN OUR FACTORY
MAROU CHOCOLATE BARS ARE MADE FROM CACAO BEANS CAREFULLY SELECTED FROM SIX PROVINCES IN SOUTHERN VIETNAM: DAK LAK, LAM DONG, DONG NAI, BA RIA, TIEN GIANG & BEN TRE.
VISIT US 167 – 169 Calmette ST, D1, HCMC

notes: made_in_vn để unknown: trang không nêu địa chỉ nhà máy (chỉ nói 'crafted entirely in our factory' và 'Vietnam's first bean-to-bar chocolate maker') — cần người kiểm tra xác nhận. vn_brand để unknown: thương hiệu do hai người sáng lập lập tại Việt Nam năm 2011, trang không tự nhận là thương hiệu Việt.

items.title: Ben Tre 78% Single Origin 80G
facts: An intense yet balanced chocolate, from Ben Tre province in the Mekong Delta, where cacao trees are planted among the coconut groves.

items.title: Tien Giang 70% Single Origin 80G
facts: Trinitario cocoa beans grown by farmers of the Cho Gao co-op in the Mekong Delta.

items.title: Lam Dong 74% Single Origin 80G
facts: made in micro-batches from cocoa beans cultivated in hilly woodland at the edge of the Vietnamese Central Highlands between Madagui and Bao Loc

items.title: Mekong Kumquat Tien Giang 68% 80G
facts: These small citrus delights grow in the lush orchards of Tien Giang province, and their bright sweetness highlights the warm spicy notes of our well-known Tien Giang chocolate

items.title: Vietnam 100% Dark Chocolate Bar
facts: made from a select blend of the mildest cacao grown by farmers in the south of Vietnam.

items.title: Ba Ria 76% Single Origin Dark Chocolate Bar
facts: A bold and fruity chocolate made from Trinitario cacao sourced directly from family-owned farms in the province of Ba Ria
